statement: A fine-tuning study with the same isolated-triple vs same-source-chunk-context design reports that context-augmented supervision improves higher-hop accuracy in every disease, evaluation setting and hop length, by roughly 1.5 to 3.8 percentage points at 3/4/5 hops.

evidence.quote: The strongest trend is that CGModel improves over KGModel in every disease, evaluation setting, and hop length.
For Gastroparesis, CGModel improves over KGModel by 1.98, 2.20, and 2.15 percentage points on KG-grounded 3-hop, 4-hop, and 5-hop QA, respectively.
